articles.title: Team selected for NASA program to explore potential lunar cave
articles.source: Phys.org - latest science and technology news stories
articles.summary: NASA has selected a Planetary Science Institute–led proposal to investigate whether a potentially large underground cave extends beyond the opening of a lunar pit.
